name: Timimus
isnote: Originally identified as an ornithomimosaur, now thought to be another kind of coelurosaur; PBDB places it in Tyrannosauroidea.
sum: Small coelurosaur from the Early Cretaceous of Australia, originally described as an ornithomimosaur.
